changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0027. Collapse per-user personal tenants into one platform tenant. There are now two kinds of tenant: the single platform tenant (owns SuperAdmin and hosts every self-registered normal user) and business tenants. Normal users become members of the platform tenant with the new restricted PersonalMember role and inherit the platform tenant's personal license; their per-user tenants and licenses are removed. Index review: no new indexes; updates ride existing keys (UX_TenantMembers_TenantId_UserId, UX_UserRoles_UserId_RoleId_TenantId, UX_TenantLicenses_TenantId). Performance note: the backfill rewrites a small number of personal rows with set-based updates keyed by TenantId.
